::: {.remark .notes}

The proof changes variables in a $p$-dimensional integral,
which these notes do not develop;
see [@wikipedia_multivariate_normal_distribution].
As with the univariate [normal distribution](random-variables.qmd#thm-normal-moments),
these facts are where the parameters' names come from.
They also show why $\matr{\covmat}$ must at least be
[positive semidefinite](variance-covariance.qmd#thm-vcov-psd);
requiring it to be positive definite rules out cases like
[a variance matrix that is not positive definite](variance-covariance.qmd#exm-vcov-singular),
which has no joint density.

:::
